Sara Farnya <sales@avicennaresearch.com>:
Dear Petra,I hope you are doing well. My name is Sara from Avicenna. We've received your request for a meeting. Thank you very much for your interest in our product and also for sharing this information about your project with us. We'd be happy to help you with your project.We built Avicenna to allow researchers and clinicians to automate their research work including field deployment, data collection, and monitoring. We’ve created a slide deck to highlight some of the features of our product.You can certainly implement your ESM study in Avicenna and send as many surveys as necessary at your desired times. There are no limitations on the number of surveys to be asked within a day and the number of questions within each survey.Generally, our pricing depends on three factors: The type of data you plan to collect (only surveys and experience sampling, or sensor data as well) The participation period (how long each participant will be enrolled in your study) The maximum number of participants you expect to enroll We offer both project-based and annual subscription licenses. Annual subscription licenses allow for an unlimited number of projects to be conducted. Actually, this could be potentially more cost-efficient because our pricing schema is much more efficient for large-scale projects than for small ones. If you think you may run multiple studies within a year, it may make sense to buy a subscription license.If you share more information about your research with us, we'd be able to help you better.If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us, or the support team. You can also visit our support knowledge base which provides helpful hints for the entire platform as well as our forum page where other researchers share their questions and thoughts.We’d love to hop on a quick call to walk you through our platform and learn more about your project. However, we will be traveling for business over the next two weeks and our schedule is somewhat unpredictable. We will be back in the office on October 23rd and can arrange a meeting at your convenience then. I’ve shared our calendar here. If your timeline is tight, please let us know, and we will do our best to find a suitable time. Best,Sara--Avicenna Research (formerly Ethica Data)4109 - 295 Adelaide St W, Toronto, ON M5V 0L4, Canada Email: sales@avicennaresearch.com - Web: https://avicennaresearch.com--
